summary: The order on the first day: You can sign an order on your first day that takes a long-held power away from the members of {the body}.
realLife: Right after her 2019 inauguration as Chicago mayor, she signed an order curbing aldermen's long-held say over permits and licenses in their wards, leaving zoning alone. Many aldermen were surprised at its reach.
